name: Retail Trauma
tagline: A browser extension that blocks checkout and roasts your purchase against your savings goals.
solution: At checkout, an overlay judges the cart against the user's goals and budget, then records purchases in a dashboard; built with a full CI/CD pipeline.
demo_moment: Team-described: try to buy something and get roasted by the mascot.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “CSE CI/CD Pipeline Challenge” among 124 submissions.
Won the CI/CD challenge, so the pipeline mattered as much as the app.

lessons: Engineering-practice prizes reward the pipeline; build it from hour one.
